sources.title: Muon: An optimizer for hidden layers in neural networks
sources.relevance: Uniform spectral whitening promotes weak modes. The original author treats their usefulness as a hypothesis; PPO need not share pretraining gradient statistics.

sources.title: Rethinking Muon Beyond Pretraining: Spectral Failures and High-Pass Remedies for VLA and RLVR
sources.relevance: A 2026 preprint reports noise amplification in VLA and RLVR and proposes spectral filtering. This motivates a discriminating test; its post-training benchmarks do not establish anything about fresh MuJoCo PPO.

sources.title: Scalable trust-region method for deep reinforcement learning using Kronecker-factored approximation
sources.relevance: ACKTR motivates using policy curvature and trust regions. A Kronecker approximation remains distinct from exact per-sample Fisher geometry and measured policy KL.

limitations: External research motivates hypotheses and is not local benchmark evidence.
No universal optimizer superiority is assumed.
